data-cy="text-block-container" class="sc-8b637a0a-0 cUMUOz sc-37cbd500-0 jSlijU text-block"><p>Who will be crowned champions of the men's football world?</p>
<p>The <strong><a href="https://www.olympics.com/en/sport-events/2026-fifa-football-world-cup">2026 FIFA World Cup</a></strong> takes place from 11 June to 19 July, as a record 48 teams compete for the sport's ultimate prize in the USA, Canada and Mexico. </p>
<p>Teams are divided into 12 groups of four, with the top two advancing to the knockout stages while the eight best third-place finishers make up the round of 32. </p>
<p>From there, it is a straight elimination format to determine the two nations who will contest the FIFA World Cup final at New York New Jersey Stadium.</p>
<p>Find all of the matches, results, scores and group standings from the tournament.</p>
